term: fully determined by law by prior occurrences (Papineau)
definition: `FullyDeterminedByLaw S e`: the occurrences satisfying S fully determine e by law, so that, starting from e, one never has to leave S to find a fully sufficient cause for it (p.8); note 2 allows the chance version, on which the chances of e are so determined. In the completeness thesis S is the prior physical occurrences. The determiners are occurrences earlier than e (facts, p.10), not beings acting at the same time; DISAMB-PRIOR-DETERMINATION-AND-MOVER separates this from the case's mover.
